steps.title: Opening Question
steps.content:
So {{contact_first_name}}, how have you felt since your last massage with us? I usually hear one of three things. Still loose and relaxed, tension starting to return, or back to where you started. Which one is closest for you?

(Only three answers. Tap the one you hear.)

steps.title: Still Feeling Good
steps.content:
That's great to hear, {{contact_first_name}}. That's exactly what we hope for when someone finishes care with us. {{provider_name}} will be glad to know you're still doing well.

(Let them respond, then continue.)

steps.title: Tension Starting to Return
steps.content:
That happens, {{contact_first_name}}. Tension can build again when regular massages stop. Your notes say massage was helping before. Where are you noticing the tension now?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Tension Fully Back
steps.content:
I'm sorry to hear that, {{contact_first_name}}. Tension often builds again when regular massages stop. Your notes say massage was helping before. What changed after you stopped coming in?

(Let them answer. Stay warm. Do not book yet.)

steps.title: Confirm Focus Areas
steps.content:
Perfect. You're set for (day) at (time).

(If focus areas are already in the notes, skip the next question.)

Before we finish, is there anything you want your therapist to focus on?

(Note their answer on the file.)

We'll see you on (day) at (time), {{contact_first_name}}.

steps.title: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I ask a few quick questions to update your massage notes?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Ask Permission
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, we'll come back to that tension. First, can I ask a few questions to update your massage notes?

(Wait for the yes.)

steps.title: Questions: Still Feeling Good
steps.content:
(Ask in order. Write down even small concerns.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

Any neck or shoulder tension?

Any low back tension?

Have you had any headaches?

How has your sleep been?

How has your stress been?

Of those, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Questions: Tension Is Back
steps.content:
(Ask in order. Write down every concern.)

{{contact_first_name}}, I'm going to run through a few things people often notice. Just say yes if you get them at all, even if they're mild or come and go.

Any neck or shoulder tension?

Any low back tension?

Have you had any headaches?

How has your sleep been?

How has your stress been?

Between {{complaint_reference}} and these concerns, which one bothers you the most?

(Tap their answer below.)

steps.title: Review Their Answers
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, let me make sure I have this right.

(Recap how long, how often, and how it affects them.)

Did I get that right?

It sounds like you'd like to feel loose and comfortable again. Is that fair to say?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: Making It Real
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'd like to ask three questions about {{main_concern}}. This will help us update your massage notes.

(Ask in order. Pause after each question.)

How long has it been bothering you, like a week or two, or longer than that?

(Let them answer.)

Is it something you experience like 1 to 2 times a month, or is it more often than that?

(Let them answer.)

When it's at its worst, does it ever interfere with work, at home, or relaxing and doing your own thing?

(Let them answer. Repeat back whatever they name.)

Thank you for sharing that. It helps us understand what you need.

steps.title: They Hesitate
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, you said {{main_concern}} has been bothering you. I don't want to assume anything. What's holding you back from booking a massage?

(Stay easy. Let them answer.)

steps.title: The Recommendation
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, can I make a recommendation?

(Wait for the yes.)

Let's get you in so {{provider_name}} can work on {{main_concern}}. We can adjust the massage around what you need. Does that sound reasonable?

(Tap what you hear.)

steps.title: Nothing Found: Keep the Rhythm
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, I'm glad you're still feeling loose and relaxed. Regular massages can help keep tension from building again.

Can I recommend booking your next massage now?

(Wait for the answer.)

We have (day) at (time) or (day) at (time). Which works better?

steps.title: Tension Is Back: Book a Massage
steps.content:
{{contact_first_name}}, thank you. Your massage notes are up to date.

Tension can keep building when massage stops. Coming in now gives us a chance to work on it.

Can I recommend booking a massage now?

(Wait for the answer.)

We have (day) at (time) or (day) at (time). Which works better?

steps.title: Objection: “I don’t have time”
steps.content:
I understand, {{contact_first_name}}. Life gets busy. We'll work around your schedule and find a massage length that fits.

Would that help?

steps.title: Objection: “I fell out of the habit”
steps.content:
That happens. Life gets busy, and massage gets pushed down the list. We can start with one visit and go from there.

Could we find a time that works?

steps.title: Objection: “Massage feels like a luxury”
steps.content:
That's fair. Massage can also be a way to care for ongoing stress and tension. Your notes say it helped before.

Would one session feel manageable?

steps.title: Objection: I’ve just been living with the tension
steps.content:
I understand. It's easy to get used to tension. A massage gives us a chance to work on what's bothering you.

Are you open to trying one visit?

steps.title: Objection: “I need to think”
steps.content:
That's fair, {{contact_first_name}}. What part would you like to think over?

(Listen. Tap another objection if they name one.)

You can start with one massage and decide what feels right afterward.

Does that make it easier?

steps.title: Objection: “Send me information”
steps.content:
I'd be glad to send information, {{contact_first_name}}. A massage is adjusted to your tension and comfort. A quick conversation cannot show exactly what will suit you.

Can we also hold a time for you?
